title: Apple seeks publisher deals to improve Siri AI
excerpt: Apple could spend nine figures on publisher deals to help Siri AI get better at keeping up with current events.
content_html:
Siri may soon be (finally) able to tell you more about what is happening in the world right now, but Apple could have to pay publishers a lot of money to make that happen.

According to an Aug. 12 report by the Wall Street Journal, Apple has approached several news publishers in recent months about giving its forthcoming Siri AI assistant access to their content. The proposed multiyear deals would help Siri answer questions about current events and other information that changes in real time.

Apple has reportedly discussed setting aside a nine-figure budget for the partnerships. Its proposed payment structure would compensate publishers whenever their reporting is used, according to the Journal. That differs from many existing AI licensing deals, which typically pay publishers a guaranteed fee in exchange for broader access to their content.

You May Also Like

It is unclear which publishers Apple has contacted or whether any agreements have been finalized. Apple declined to comment to the Journal.

The negotiations come as Apple prepares to roll out a significantly upgraded version of Siri. Siri AI is expected to enter beta later this year, with new capabilities that allow the assistant to understand personal context, recognize what is on a user’s screen, and complete actions across apps.

Mashable Light Speed

Apple already has established relationships with publishers through Apple News+, its paid news subscription service that launched in 2019. The company has also previously paid for access to content through deals that included the right to use publishers’ work for AI training, the Journal reported.

Apple has also already learned how quickly AI-generated news can go wrong. In late 2024, the company began offering AI-generated notification summaries that sometimes rewrote news alerts inaccurately. Apple eventually disabled the feature for news and entertainment apps following complaints from publishers.

The latest talks arrive as news organizations decide how, or whether, to work with the companies building AI products. Publishers, including News Corp and Axel Springer, have signed content deals with OpenAI, while The New York Times is suing OpenAI and Microsoft over the alleged unauthorized use of its reporting.

For publishers, Apple’s proposed pay-per-use system would offer another way to make money from the AI products increasingly answering questions that once sent readers directly to news websites. For Apple, it could help ensure that when users ask Siri what is happening right now, the assistant finally has a useful answer.

Disclosure: Ziff Davis, Mashable’s parent company, in April 2025 filed a lawsuit against OpenAI, alleging it infringed Ziff Davis copyrights in training and operating its AI systems.

content_html_zh:
Siri 可能很快就能（最终）告诉你更多关于世界上正在发生的事情，但苹果可能需要向出版商支付大量资金才能实现这一目标。

据《华尔街日报》8 月 12 日报道，近几个月来，苹果公司已与多家新闻出版商接洽，希望为其即将推出的 Siri 人工智能助手提供访问其内容的权限。 拟议的多年协议将帮助 Siri 回答有关时事和其他实时变化信息的问题。

据报道，苹果公司已讨论为合作伙伴关系预留九位数的预算。 据《华尔街日报》报道，其提议的付款结构将在出版商的报告被使用时向其提供补偿。 这与许多现有的人工智能许可协议不同，后者通常向出版商支付有保证的费用，以换取更广泛的内容访问权限。

你可能也喜欢

目前尚不清楚苹果已经联系了哪些出版商，也不清楚是否已敲定任何协议。 苹果拒绝向《华尔街日报》发表评论。

此次谈判正值苹果准备推出大幅升级版 Siri 之际。 Siri AI 预计将在今年晚些时候进入测试阶段，其新功能使助手能够了解个人背景、识别用户屏幕上的内容以及跨应用程序完成操作。

可混搭光速

Apple 已通过 2019 年推出的付费新闻订阅服务 Apple News+ 与出版商建立了关系。 据《华尔街日报》报道，该公司此前还通过交易支付了内容访问费用，其中包括使用出版商​​作品进行人工智能培训的权利。

苹果也已经了解到人工智能生成的新闻出错的速度有多快。 2024 年底，该公司开始提供人工智能生成的通知摘要，有时会不准确地重写新闻警报。 在出版商投诉后，苹果最终禁用了新闻和娱乐应用程序的该功能。

随着新闻机构决定如何或是否与构建人工智能产品的公司合作，最新的会谈也随之而来。 包括新闻集团和 Axel Springer 在内的出版商已与 OpenAI 签署内容协议，而《纽约时报》则起诉 OpenAI 和微软涉嫌未经授权使用其报道。

对于出版商来说，苹果提出的按使用付费系统将提供另一种从人工智能产品中赚钱的方式，这些产品越来越多地回答曾经将读者直接发送到新闻网站的问题。 对于苹果来说，它可以帮助确保当用户询问 Siri 现在发生了什么时，助手最终能得到有用的答案。

披露：Mashable 的母公司 Ziff Davis 于 2025 年 4 月对 OpenAI 提起诉讼，指控其在训练和运营其人工智能系统时侵犯了 Ziff Davis 的版​​权。
